note: Temperature/RH bands are quoted from the cited sources. Durations (warning/critical/stale) and plausibility limits are Irminsul assumptions for alerting, not standards.

assumptions: Warning after 30 minutes continuously outside the band; critical after 120 minutes.
A zone is stale when no reading arrives for 30 minutes (assumed sensor interval: up to 15 minutes).
Implausible: temperature outside -10…50 °C, RH outside 5…100 %, or a jump of more than 8 °C within 10 minutes.
'Unusual' = latest reading more than 3 standard deviations from the mean of the previous 24 readings (needs at least 12). Information only.
